personas.tagline: Big mission. Short fuse. Needs brakes before orbit.
personas.intro: A rocket-speed builder who treats delay like a software bug.
personas.wisePath: Move boldly, but install real brakes before people become test pilots.
personas.blindSpot: The mission can start sounding holier than the humans it affects.

personas.tagline: Every crisis deserves a group chat and three reaction buttons.
personas.intro: A platform mayor who sees connection everywhere, even in a rage spiral.
personas.wisePath: Build connection that makes people freer, calmer, and more truthful.
personas.blindSpot: A room full of reactions can still be a lonely room.

personas.intro: A data monarch who brings a spreadsheet to an awkward moral silence.
personas.wisePath: Use evidence carefully, then ask what the evidence cannot measure.
personas.blindSpot: Page one can look like truth while skipping the wounded person.

personas.intro: A calm design guardian who solves chaos by removing buttons.
personas.wisePath: Make the good path easy without hiding the real choice.
personas.blindSpot: A walled garden can become a velvet cage.

personas.tagline: Probably safe. The next model will explain why.
personas.intro: A charming futurist who can turn uncertainty into a launch plan.
personas.wisePath: Let AI advise, but keep moral responsibility with accountable humans.
personas.blindSpot: A confidence score can start sounding like a commandment.

personas.tagline: More GPUs. More cooling. Same soul problem.
personas.intro: A forge master who treats every problem like a workload waiting for compute.
personas.wisePath: Ask what the power is for before making it faster.
personas.blindSpot: Not every human problem becomes moral when rendered in 4K.
